sources.snippet: For complex equipment, product life-cycle management (PLM) including remaining useful life (RUL) is one of the essential issues for industrial intelligence. In this paper, a tensor-based remaining useful life prediction model is proposed to facilitate the life-cycle management, which combines features from time domain and frequency domain.
